blocks.text: Incus manages system containers and virtual machines through its configured local or remote endpoint. The incus client sends the requested operation to that endpoint; Help only documents commands and never contacts an Incus daemon.

incus remote list
incus image list images: debian
incus launch images:debian/13 dev-shell
incus list
Check the remote and image alias before launching. A launch creates a named instance and may allocate storage and network resources. Use an image publisher and release that you trust.

incus exec dev-shell -- bash
incus file push ./config.toml dev-shell/root/config.toml
incus file pull dev-shell/root/report.txt ./report.txt
incus exec runs the selected command in the instance. File transfers use explicit source and destination paths; check both sides before copying credentials or replacing a file.

incus profile show default
incus storage list
incus config device add dev-shell data disk source=example-data path=/srv/data
Profiles provide reusable limits and devices. Adding a disk device changes the instance's storage view; verify the source and destination before applying it.

incus stop dev-shell
incus delete --force dev-shell
Remote selection, instance deletion, storage changes and network devices affect real resources. Confirm the target and preserve data before using destructive commands.
